# Environments

| Environment | Given | Deliver | Scored by | Admission gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`Scanner/Explore-v0`](scanner-explore-v0/) | A head, an abdomen or a QA phantom at 1.5 or 3 T; one hour of scan time | Nothing | No reward | no reward |
| [`Scanner/NoWrap-v0`](scanner-nowrap-v0/) | An object of hidden size, orientation and position; the scanner; 30 s of scan time for localisers | Geometry of a spin-echo scan: phase-encode axis, field of view, phase field of view, matrix | Re-scan on the hidden object: whole object inside, no wrap-around, pixel as required; then scan time against the fastest valid geometry | admitted: 28/48 instances (58%) |
| [`Scanner/T1Transmit-v0`](scanner-t1transmit-v0/) | A QA phantom with 4 to 7 vials, the scanner, a scan-time budget of 45 to 100 s | T1 of every marked vial, in ms | RMS relative T1 error against the hidden phantom; full marks inside the reference policy's own noise band | practice: rejected by its gate (0/72 instances admitted) |

An **environment** is one job on the scanner with its own scoring rule. A **level** sets the hidden-world prior and the budget. An **episode** is one seeded attempt. The admission gate is described in [docs/DESIGN.md](../docs/DESIGN.md); `mrgym check <id> --admission` reruns it.
